row.name: Insight Enterprises Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)
checks.note: today would be breakout 4 of this move

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=3 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.14 tightness=0.61 base_volume_vs_leg=0.57 base_volume_vs_avg=0.63
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close 7.7% vs its 20-SMA, 5.6% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 3 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The Y criterion is a hard fail: this is the fourth breakout of a 54-session, 52% move, and the chart confirms it — three prior burst bars are visible climbing the same staircase since early August, with price now extended well above the rising 20-day average. The base is only three bars and visually tight, but launching a fourth push out of a mature, extended trend is exactly the 'third-day buyer becomes the bag holder at a larger scale' pattern the rules flag. Volume rank of 40 out of 60 sessions is mediocre and does not compensate.
claude.key_risk: Four breakouts into a 52% move means most of the easy money is already made; any sector rotation or broad market weakness hits a crowded, extended name with no nearby support.
claude.entry_note: Skip if tomorrow opens above today's close (gap over the ceiling) or if the first 30 minutes show a fade back below 162 — the burst bar's body would be compromised and the setup collapses.

row.summary: NSIT: +6.1% on 1.6× volume out of a base 4.8% deep. C 8.5, 5 of 6 criteria.
